title: Copying of Callibration settings
symptom: The user wants to copy calibration settings from one device to another, as their daughter uses a smartwatch and a phone as collectors for the same Dexcom G5 transmitter.
fix: The suggested fix is to manually copy calibration data by entering engineering mode on the watch, calibrating on the phone, waiting 10 minutes, then setting slope and intercept on the watch's calibration graph.
evidence_quote: The fastest way to do that is to copy the calibration data manually. That is "enter engineering mode" on the watch. After that, calibrate on the phone. wait 10 minutes for calibration data to be stabilize on phone. on the watch, go to calibration graph, and (if you are in engineering mode) you can set the slope and intercept to follow the data on the watch.
